source.note: Names, icons and light/dark setup colours copied from the local Timing checkout. Descriptions follow v2.2.4 documentation.

systems.title: Fuel Systems
systems.text: Manage tank capacity, fuel consumption and refuelling to make every pit stop count.

systems.title: Penalty Systems
systems.text: Set penalty points, escalating consequences, time additions and forced pit stops.

systems.title: Damage Systems
systems.text: Add damage and car failures, with repairs, race effects and retirement rules.

systems.title: Safety Car Systems
systems.text: Control yellow-flag pace, speeding penalties and optional random safety-car periods.

systems.title: Tyre Wear Systems
systems.text: Choose compounds, wear, tyre changes and optional temperature and warm-up effects.

systems.title: Weather Systems
systems.text: Bring changing conditions, tyre suitability and weather effects into your race.

systems.title: Push & Save Systems
systems.text: Push harder at a resource cost, or conserve fuel and tyres with a gentler pace.

systems.title: Rotation Setups
systems.text: Plan heats and lane rotations so every driver or team gets their turn.

systems.title: Championships
systems.text: Connect rounds with points, bonuses, dropped results, team standings and tie-breaks.

systems.title: Balance of Power
systems.text: Balance cars through fuel use, refuelling speed and tank capacity. Requires a Fuel System.

systems.title: Time Tokens
systems.text: Give each lane an allowance of track time, with adjustments and expiry warnings.

systems.title: Virtual Rival Systems
systems.text: Race against replay opponents built from saved lap sequences.

systems.title: Multi-Class Systems
systems.text: Race different car classes together or in class heats, with overall and class results.

systems.title: Resource Systems
systems.text: Allocate tyre sets, repair credits and replacement parts across races or championships.
